{{Quote|Darling, ''nothing'' can grow on Metalorn... It's a factory planet.|Tammia Hollusen's mother|<ref name="MSW30" />}}
'''Tammia Hollusen's mother''' was a worker in shift 114E on the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Factory world/Legends|factory world]] of [[Metalorn/Legends|Metalorn]]. Her [[Tammia Hollusen|daughter]] was supposed to be in the [[learning center]] while she was on shift, but Tammi would sneak out to try to grow plants in the nutrient-starved soil, a practice her mother tried to dissuade her from. Tammia Hollusen's mother wanted to spend time with her daughter, but the strict regimentation of Metalorn, overseen by Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtroopers]], made that difficult.
